summary: One toggle inside the app kills Ask Photos, Gemini-powered memories and the AI search that replaced normal search. It is a genuine off switch — you just have to know it exists.

steps.path: Google Photos → profile icon → Photos settings → Preferences → Gemini features in Photos → toggle off "Use Gemini in Photos"

collateral: natural-language photo search goes back to keyword search
auto-generated memories and remix suggestions stop
whyTheyDidIt: Your photo library is the most personal training and engagement surface Google has on your phone.
